node.statement: Small branch. Assume e<=min(e_0,1), ||T||<=a*delta, and put D=4*a^3+k*a. Since (L_T R_T)(T)=T(TT)=T(T^2), two applications of (ii) give ||(L_T R_T)(T)||<=(1+epsilon)^2||T||^3<=4*a^3*e^3<=4*a^3*e. Moreover (iii) gives ||u_T-(L_T R_T)(T)||<=k*e*||T||<=k*a*e^2<=k*a*e. Hence ||u_T||<=D*e, and therefore ||u_T||<=1+D*e.
